title: The fixed untwisted comparison intertwines b^n scalar endomorphisms on open cohomology with a^n on raw section cohomology.
statement:
The fixed untwisted comparison intertwines b^n scalar endomorphisms on open cohomology with a^n on raw section cohomology. For all objects and arguments in the following signature, using [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], [def-sc-open-module-cohomology], [def-pc-resolution-open-comparison-map].

theorem resolution_open_scalar_core {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ)
    (W : T.Opens) (a : Γ(T, W))
    (R : RestrictedResolutionSections I (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)) :
    let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let P := sectionCohomologyPresheaf K q
    let Y := (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme
    let : CommRing (Y.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op ⊤)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (CommRing Γ(Y, ⊤))
  let G := (restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj F
    let b := ((f.app W) ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).topIso.inv).hom a
    let c := resolutionOpenComparison f F I q W R
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : P.obj (op W)),
      (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q ⊤).map
        (G.smulHom (b ^ n)) (c x) = c (a ^ n • x)

source.place: Tags 01E1 and 01E4; restriction of resolutions and computation of cohomology from them

proof.text: Build the chain endomorphism phi by multiplication by b^n, and check it lifts G.smulHom(b^n) using smulHom_naturality. Apply isoRightDerivedObj_hom_naturality for top-open sections. On module-valued section homology, phi induces multiplication by b^n: use smulHom_app_top_apply, ShortComplex.homologyMap_smul, and mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality for forgetting scalars. Apply resolutionSectionsHomology_scalar to a^n, rewriting the pullback ring map by cancellation of the canonical affine chart and topIso. Compose this scalar equality with the naturality equation, and use injectivity and inverse identities of resolutionOpenComparison to obtain the result.
